regulations.enforcement_body: Individual Pocono municipalities (Tobyhanna Twp, Mt. Pocono, etc.)
regulations.notes: The Pocono Mountains STR market is regulated at the municipal level — each township/borough has its own rules. Tobyhanna Township's ordinance was revised in Feb 2024 to set occupancy at 2 per bedroom + 2. Mount Pocono requires a license per ecode360. Monroe County Hotel Excise Tax and PA sales tax apply. Regulations vary widely by municipality.
